question: Should experimental Claw packages canonicalize `CLAW.md` now, before maintainers define the multi-agent composition, role, parent-identity, and policy contract?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but neither tests nor CI can determine whether a public manifest filename should become part of the package contract before the adjacent semantic boundary is decided.

options.title: Defer canonical `CLAW.md`
options.body: Hold this slice and retain the JSON export contract until the agent-package and composition semantics are explicitly agreed.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental format
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as the temporary canonical export and require explicit package-consumer compatibility and documentation guidance before landing.
